data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to manage contacts for an atSign using the atPlatform.
data.what_it_does: Provides UI screens and functions for managing contacts in an atPlatform application. Allows developers to add, delete, block, and unblock contacts with end-to-end encryption.
use_when: Building an application using the atPlatform ecosystem
Needing out-of-the-box contact management UI screens like Contacts and Blocked Contacts
avoid_when: Building standard apps that do not use the atPlatform decentralized model
Needing a general-purpose local device contact picker without atSigns
strengths: Built-in UI screens for contact management and blocked contacts
Follows atPlatform's decentralized, end-to-end encrypted model with no backend required
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the atPlatform architecture
Requires specific initialization steps for services and SizeConfig
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the contacts service with a root domain and calling SizeConfig().init(context) if using UI widgets.
